verdict.rationale: Qdrant's own docs describe Qdrant Private Cloud as a first-party way to manage Qdrant clusters in any Kubernetes cluster, which is direct Kubernetes deployment support. The evidence never names a Helm chart or an operator, and gives no production deployment detail. missing for 10: explicit official Helm chart documentation, explicit Kubernetes operator documentation, production configuration guidance for Kubernetes (scaling, upgrades, persistence), independent or hands-on corroboration of Kubernetes deployments.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can deploy to production on Kubernetes with an official Helm chart or operator

citations.quote: Qdrant Private Cloud allows you to manage Qdrant database clusters in any Kubernetes cluster on any infrastructure.
